data.name: Pranay
data.long_meaning: Pranay means 'love', 'desire', or 'breath'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'prana' meaning 'breath' and 'ay' meaning 'love'. This name reflects the deep connection between the breath of life and the emotions of love and desire.
